rubric.name: ossie-relational-bundle plan r1 review
criteria: MVP first: classify every concern as blocking, hardening, or completeness, and report blocking concerns first. A concern is blocking only if, left unfixed, the software does not demonstrably do what it claims. Do not manufacture completeness concerns to avoid an empty return -- "no concerns, and here is what I checked" is a valid answer.
Cite one concrete plan location for every concern; evidence must cite the plan file itself.

Check every observed baseline claim in plan section 1.2 against the code it names (src/gnd/export/ossie.py, src/gnd/ossie_import.py, src/gnd/commands/export.py, src/gnd/schema/ossie/core-spec.json) and report any that is false.

Check that every request of the three source issues summarized in plan section 1.1 (I1-I3) is owned by a phase criterion or an explicit decision, and that no completion predicate is unfalsifiable or untestable in this repository.
Check phase ordering and dependencies for cycles, optional work supplying mandatory prerequisites, and phases that cannot be specified until a decision is ruled.

Check the proposed Halpin Rmap semantics (section 2.3), the D2 default-output change and the physical-binding design for compatibility breaks, ambiguous rules, and hostile-input or time-bound gaps against the project's standing rules in section 0.
The draft OB1 spec at notes/phase-OB1-spec.md is context only; a concern about it must still cite the plan location it derives from.
